cases.title: CSV Data Cleaner
cases.user_goal: Create a local tool that cleans CSV files, removes duplicate rows, normalizes whitespace, reports malformed rows, and writes a clean CSV plus a concise summary.

hard_requirements.description: Accept a CSV input path and output path
Remove exact duplicate data rows while preserving the header
Normalize surrounding cell whitespace
Report malformed rows without silently corrupting data

hidden_acceptance.description: A real process cleans a mixed CSV correctly
Malformed input is explicitly reported
Documented local entry point starts and exits correctly
The emitted CSV remains readable after the cleaner process exits
Summary counts match the actual emitted file

runtime_requirements: Run offline from the delivered project
Return a non-zero status for unusable input
visual_requirements: Human-readable console summary; a GUI is not required
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes source, README, and test instructions

cases.title: Markdown Batch Converter
cases.user_goal: Build a local batch converter that turns a folder of Markdown files into readable HTML files, preserves links and code blocks, and produces an index of converted documents.
allowed_assumptions: Output may use a shared stylesheet

hard_requirements.description: Convert every Markdown file in an input folder
Preserve links and fenced code blocks
Generate a navigable output index

hidden_acceptance.description: Nested mixed documents are converted
Links and code remain semantically intact
Batch command executes on a clean local environment
Generated pages remain usable after the converter process exits
Every generated page is linked from the index

runtime_requirements: One documented local command processes a folder
visual_requirements: Generated HTML is readable at desktop and mobile widths
delivery_requirements: Package includes examples, README, and test instructions

cases.title: Local Project Board
cases.user_goal: Create a local project board where I can add, edit, delete, and move task cards between To Do, In Progress, and Done, with data preserved after restart and an export option.

hard_requirements.description: Create, edit, and delete task cards
Move cards among all three columns
Persist board data across restart
Export the board without losing fields

hidden_acceptance.description: External actions exercise create, edit, and delete
A card moves through the workflow
The local application responds over its documented interface
State survives a fresh process
Export matches stored card state

runtime_requirements: Start locally without an external database
State remains after a process restart
visual_requirements: Three columns and card actions are visibly distinguishable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes source, README, and reset instructions

cases.title: Personal Inventory Manager
cases.user_goal: Build a local personal inventory manager for items, quantities, locations, categories, and notes, with search, low-stock visibility, editing, deletion, and CSV import/export.

hard_requirements.description: Manage all requested item fields
Search and filter inventory
Identify low-stock items
Round-trip CSV import and export

hidden_acceptance.description: Items can be created, edited, and deleted
Search finds only matching items
Application starts locally
Changes survive restart
CSV round trip preserves values
Low-stock calculation is accurate

visual_requirements: Inventory table/list, filters, and low-stock state are clear
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes a sample CSV and README

cases.title: Personal Finance Tracker
cases.user_goal: Create a privacy-first local personal finance tracker for income and expenses, categories, monthly budgets, recurring entries, filters, summaries, and CSV import/export.

hard_requirements.description: Record income and expense transactions
Calculate monthly summaries and budget remaining
Apply recurring entries deterministically
Round-trip CSV without changing amounts

hidden_acceptance.description: Transaction lifecycle and filters work
Signed totals and budgets are exact
Application runs locally
Ledger survives restart
Recurring entries do not duplicate on rerun
CSV round trip preserves decimal amounts

visual_requirements: Monthly balance, category spend, and budget state are readily readable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes schema/migration notes and README

cases.title: Notes + Search Workspace
cases.user_goal: Build a local notes workspace with folders or tags, Markdown notes, full-text search, editing, deletion, recent notes, and import/export that keeps note metadata.
allowed_assumptions: Folders, tags, or both may organize notes

hard_requirements.description: Create and edit Markdown notes with metadata
Search note titles and bodies
Show recent notes in deterministic order
Import/export preserves metadata

hidden_acceptance.description: Notes and organization metadata are editable
Search handles title and body matches
Workspace runs locally
Notes survive restart
Recent order reflects edits
Export/import preserves metadata and Markdown

runtime_requirements: Search works on a clean restart
visual_requirements: Navigation, editor, rendered content, and search results are distinct

cases.title: Image Batch Processor
cases.user_goal: Create a local image batch processor that resizes, crops, rotates, renames, and converts common image formats, preserves originals by default, previews planned work, and reports failures per file.
allowed_assumptions: Operations may be configured per batch

hard_requirements.description: Perform resize, crop, rotate, rename, and format conversion
Preserve originals unless explicitly overridden
Preview the planned batch
Continue safely and report per-file failures

hidden_acceptance.description: Pixel dimensions and formats match requested operations
Source hashes remain unchanged by default
Batch process runs locally on real images
Preview corresponds to executed outputs
A bad file does not corrupt successful outputs

runtime_requirements: Process multiple images in one invocation
visual_requirements: Preview communicates source, operation, and destination clearly
delivery_requirements: Runnable package declares image dependencies and includes test instructions

cases.title: RSS Reading Dashboard
cases.user_goal: Build a local RSS reading dashboard where I can manage feeds, refresh articles, filter unread or saved items, mark reading state, search, and continue using previously fetched data when offline.
allowed_assumptions: Network is available only during refresh

hard_requirements.description: Add, edit, delete, and refresh feeds
Deduplicate articles across refreshes
Persist read and saved state
Browse cached articles offline

hidden_acceptance.description: Feed lifecycle works against controlled HTTP feeds
Repeat refresh produces no duplicates
Dashboard and refresh worker start together
Reading state survives restart
Cached content remains usable with feed server stopped

visual_requirements: Feed list, article list, detail view, and state indicators are usable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes local storage and network configuration guidance

cases.title: Local REST Service + Dashboard
cases.user_goal: Create a local REST service and browser dashboard for managing records with validation, filtering, pagination, durable storage, clear API errors, health status, and setup documentation.
allowed_assumptions: A simple record domain may be chosen and documented

hard_requirements.description: REST CRUD returns correct status codes and JSON
Validation, filtering, and pagination are enforced server-side
Dashboard uses the REST API rather than separate state
Records persist across server restart

hidden_acceptance.description: External HTTP client verifies CRUD and errors
Filtering and pagination return correct subsets
Service health and dashboard respond
API data survives a process restart
Dashboard mutations are visible through the API

runtime_requirements: Bind to a configurable local port
visual_requirements: Dashboard supports list, create, edit, errors, and pagination without overlap
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes API examples, setup, and test instructions

cases.title: Customer Feedback Manager
cases.user_goal: I need a practical local application that helps a small product team collect, organize, understand, and act on customer feedback.
allowed_assumptions: The product should explain its chosen workflow

hard_requirements.description: Turn the ambiguous goal into a coherent end-to-end feedback workflow
Preserve feedback records and meaningful action state
Provide useful organization and understanding, not storage alone
Enable traceable follow-up actions

hidden_acceptance.description: A dynamic evaluator can complete a coherent feedback-to-action workflow
Organization and insight features add demonstrated value
The chosen product starts and remains usable locally
Feedback and action state survive restart
Collection, understanding, and action states remain connected

runtime_requirements: The evaluator may create an unseen multi-step scenario
visual_requirements: Information hierarchy makes intake, analysis, and action understandable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes rationale, setup, and operational guidance
